findings.title: CVE-2026-120722: F5 BIG-IP iRule can crash system and allow code execution
findings.summary_md: StackFlag records CVE-2026-120722, a CVSS 9.8 CWE-121 stack-based buffer overflow triggered when a BIG-IP virtual server runs an iRule using the DNS::scrape command. Undisclosed requests can terminate the Traffic Management Microkernel and may allow unauthenticated remote code execution; the issue is data-plane only, and the page says it is not known to be exploited. Listed fixes are BIGIP-21.1.0.4.0.19.3-ENG for BIG-IP and BNK-2.4.2-EHF1 for BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes, with F5 advisory K000163945 cited.

findings.title: CVE-2026-123637: F5 BIG-IP APM may crash and enable code execution
findings.summary_md: StackFlag records CVE-2026-123637, a stack-based buffer overflow in BIG-IP APM when a per-request policy with the Client Information and Endpoint Security agents is applied to a virtual server. Undisclosed requests can terminate the Traffic Management Microkernel and may permit unauthenticated remote code execution; the page lists severity 9.3 and says the flaw is not known to be exploited. The fix named is BIGIP-21.1.0.4.0.19.3-ENG, with F5 advisory K000163937 cited as the vendor reference.

findings.title: NVD-CVE-2026-123637
findings.summary_md: The NVD record for CVE-2026-123637 was published from F5 SIRT on 18 November 2026 and describes APM per-request policies with the Client Information and Endpoint Security agents as the trigger. Undisclosed requests can terminate the Traffic Management Microkernel and may lead to remote code execution, with no control-plane exposure and no evaluation of End of Technical Support versions. The record cites F5 advisory K000163937.

findings.title: CVE-2026-123637: F5 BIG-IP: When BIG-IP APM is provisioned and a per-request policy that includes the Client Information agent and Endpoint…
findings.summary_md: Rapid7's vulnerability entry describes the CVE-2026-123637 trigger as an APM per-request policy containing Client Information and Endpoint Security agents on a virtual server. It gives CVSS 4.0 at 9.3 and CVSS 3.1 at 9.8, states that the flaw is data-plane only and lists no EPSS score and no CISA KEV inclusion. The entry was published on 18 November 2026.
